NEW: 

🇮🇷🇺🇸 Iran has transferred 15 unexploded US missiles to "technical and research units" for reverse engineering, according to Iranian media

This includes a fully intact GBU-57 bunker buster that failed to detonate during strikes on Iran's nuclear sites. https://t.co/7oCwpXvnnM

description.description: A wide shot shows two military personnel in camouflage uniforms standing in a hangar next to a large, olive-drab training ordnance mounted on a heavy-duty transport vehicle. The ordnance is marked with 'TRAINER' and 'NOT FOR FLIGHT'. The hangar features industrial infrastructure like conduits, a control panel, and a polished gray floor.
